description: This file defines an enum called FuelAutoTune which implements the FuelAutoLogic interface, containing methods and logic related to auto-tuning fuel parameters based on ECU data points. It includes algorithms for optimizing a fuel map using deviation calculations, smoothing, and iterative adjustments.

classes.name: FuelAutoTune
classes.description: Enum singleton implementing fuel auto-tuning logic, including processing data points to optimize fuel map values.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method to process collection of AFR data points and perform auto-tuning, returning the result map.

methods.name: getTotalDeviationAfterCellOptimization
methods.description: Optimizes a single cell in the fuel map to minimize total deviation.

methods.name: countDeviation
methods.description: Calculates the deviation of AFR data points relative to the target AFR and current map.

methods.name: smooth
methods.description: Applies smoothing to the deviation map to enforce uniformity or reduce noise.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs a message to standard output.
